root.label: Complex Adaptive Systems
root.summary: A relatively new field of study originating at the Santa Fe Institute, focusing on systems with emergent behavior and adaptation.

cas_concepts.label: Core Concepts of CAS
cas_concepts.summary: Fundamental ideas defining Complex Adaptive Systems.

complexity_definition.label: Complexity
complexity_definition.summary: Results from the inter-relationship, inter-action, and inter-connectivity of elements within a system and its environment. Rooted in the Latin 'plexus' and 'complexus'.

cas_definition.label: Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS)
cas_definition.summary: Systems exhibiting complex behaviors emerging from nonlinear interactions among many components at different levels of organization.

cas_attributes.label: Attributes of CAS
cas_attributes.summary: Characteristics that define and distinguish Complex Adaptive Systems.

distributed_control.label: Distributed Control
distributed_control.summary: No single centralized control mechanism governs system behavior; coherence arises from inter-relationships.

connectivity.label: Connectivity
connectivity.summary: Complexity arises from the inter-relationship and inter-connectivity of elements within and between systems.

co_evolution.label: Co-evolution
co_evolution.summary: Elements in a system change based on interactions with each other and the environment; patterns change over time.

sensitive_dependence.label: Sensitive Dependence on Initial Conditions
sensitive_dependence.summary: Small changes in input can have profound impacts on overall behavior, making long-term prediction difficult.

emergent_order.label: Emergent Order
emergent_order.summary: Global properties arise from the aggregate behavior of individual agents, not predictable from individual understanding.

far_from_equilibrium.label: Far From Equilibrium
far_from_equilibrium.summary: Systems pushed away from equilibrium can survive and thrive, creating new structures and patterns.

state_of_paradox.label: State of Paradox
state_of_paradox.summary: Dynamics combining both order and chaos, characterized by stability and instability.

history_origins.label: History and Origins
history_origins.summary: The development and key figures in the field of Complex Adaptive Systems.

santa_fe_institute.label: Santa Fe Institute (SFI)
santa_fe_institute.summary: A multidisciplinary research center founded in 1984, dedicated to the study of emerging science and complex systems.

gell_mann.label: Murray Gell-Mann
gell_mann.summary: Co-Chairman of the Science Board of SFI and Nobel laureate for his work on elementary particles; now focuses on CAS.

holland.label: John Holland
holland.summary: Founder of the domain of genetic algorithms, used for problem-solving, optimization, and modeling ecological systems.

kauffman.label: Stuart Kauffman
kauffman.summary: Biologist investigating how networks of genes can give rise to organ differentiation; explores self-organization and evolution.

prigogine.label: Ilya Prigogine
prigogine.summary: Nobel laureate in chemistry for his work on non-equilibrium thermodynamics and dissipative structures.

goodwin.label: Brian Goodwin
goodwin.summary: Professor of biology focusing on 'new' biology – the study of complex systems dealing with dynamics and emergent order.
